mission_09: Adversarial data augmentation uses intentionally crafted perturbations to improve model robustness. FGSM (Fast Gradient Sign Method) is one of the simplest and most effective adversarial attack algorithms. It computes the gradient of the loss function with respect to the input image, then adds a small perturbation in the direction that maximizes the loss. By training on these adversarial examples alongside clean data, models learn to be robust against worst-case perturbations. This technique bridges the gap between data augmentation and adversarial training, serving dual purposes: expanding the training set and improving model security. The epsilon parameter controls the perturbation magnitude, balancing between imperceptibility and effectiveness.
